related_questions.question: How long after being exposed to COVID can you pass it on?
related_questions.snippet: Researchers estimate that people who get infected with COVID-19 can spread it to others 2-3 days before symptoms start and are most contagious 1-2 days before they feel sick. if you have the Omicron variant, you may become contagious more quickly because of its shorter COVID-19 incubation period.

related_questions.question: How long do you have to quarantine with COVID in New Mexico?
related_questions.snippet: Stay home for at least 5 days. You DO NOT need to get an additional PCR test if you have had a positive at-home rapid test. If you never had symptoms, you can leave your house after 5 days, but wear a mask for 5 more days. If you had symptoms, ending isolation depends on how serious your symptoms were.

related_questions.question: Do you still have to quarantine with COVID-19 now?
related_questions.snippet: Updated Guidance: The updated Respiratory Virus Guidance recommends that people stay home and away from others until at least 24 hours after both their symptoms are getting better overall, and they have not had a fever (and are not using fever-reducing medication).
